name: atm-dashboard
description: Source for the Agentic Task Manager dashboard. Builds to a single self-contained HTML file.

scripts.build: pnpm run build:page && vite build -c vite.compmd.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm run build:page && playwright test --grep-invert visual
scripts.check: node scripts/check-versions.mjs && node scripts/check-compmd-assets.mjs && svelte-check --fail-on-warnings && eslint . && prettier --config .prettierrc --check . ../tests/scripts
scripts.verify: pnpm run build:cli && pnpm run check && pnpm run test:coverage && pnpm run build && pnpm run test:scripts && pnpm run test:e2e && pnpm run test:e2e:visual
scripts.prepare: svelte-kit sync && (git -C .. config core.hooksPath .githooks 2>/dev/null || echo "prepare: git hooks not enabled (not a usable git checkout, e.g. CI)")
scripts.test:e2e:visual: docker run --rm -v "$(cd .. && pwd)":/repo -v atm-dashboard-linux-modules:/repo/dashboard/node_modules -w /repo/dashboard mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.64.1-noble@sha256:47b510dd9230bf0b9bfc9b20102241e577ea7a99334ab4c3ca19f19770e9b8ea sh -c "npm install --global --silent pnpm@12.14.0 && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm run build && pnpm exec playwright test visual"
scripts.test:e2e:visual:update: docker run --rm -v "$(cd .. && pwd)":/repo -v atm-dashboard-linux-modules:/repo/dashboard/node_modules -w /repo/dashboard mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.64.1-noble@sha256:47b510dd9230bf0b9bfc9b20102241e577ea7a99334ab4c3ca19f19770e9b8ea sh -c "npm install --global --silent pnpm@12.14.0 && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm run build && pnpm exec playwright test visual --update-snapshots=changed"
